parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 1.1.5.2/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-options autonomous-system 10.explanation: 配置路由选项中的自治系统号。

parameters.name: autonomous-system
parameters.explanation: 自治系统号，用于标识一个自治系统。

set protocols bgp group external peer-ad.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] peer-address [parameter2] internal as [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group external peer-ad.command: set protocols bgp group external peer-address 1.1.5.1 internal as 100
set protocols bgp group external peer-ad.explanation: 配置BGP协议的外部组，指定对等地址和内部自治系统号。

set policies from prefix1 to prefix1 ter.template: set policies from [parameter1] to [parameter2] term [parameter3] then [parameter4] address-family [parameter5]
set policies from prefix1 to prefix1 ter.command: set policies from prefix1 to prefix1 term permit-addr then permit address-family inet
set policies from prefix1 to prefix1 ter.explanation: 配置策略，允许从指定前缀到指定前缀的流量，并指定地址族。

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 对匹配流量的操作，例如permit。

set vlans vid 1 interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit.command: set vlans vid 1 interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0
set vlans vid 1 interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit.explanation: 配置VLAN的VID，并关联到指定接口和单元。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-instance ri-to-null ip route.command: set routing-instance ri-to-null ip route 2.2.2.0/24 null0
set routing-instance ri-to-null ip route.explanation: 在路由实例中配置指向null0的静态路由。

set routing-instance ri-to-null ip route.command: set routing-instance ri-to-null ip route 3.3.3.0/24 null0
set routing-instance ri-to-null ip route.explanation: 在路由实例中配置指向null0的静态路由。

set routing-instance ri-to-null ip route.command: set routing-instance ri-to-null ip route 4.4.4.0/24 null0
set routing-instance ri-to-null ip route.explanation: 在路由实例中配置指向null0的静态路由。
